messages.subject: rmr 2.2.2 released
parts:
Hi everyone,
rmr2.2.2 is now available for download. It fixes a couple of bugs one of which was not obvious to detect and produced incorrect data, so an upgrade is highly recommended. Thanks for the great feedback that allowed us to squash this one. 


Antonio

something went wrong with the build, we managed to replace the windows build before a single download but the unix build already had a handful of downloads. If you downloaded the unix build before 9:15 AM PDT please repeat your download.  Please accept my apologies for the mishap.


Antonio
